name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Butter'
story_html: Kanye West and adidas continued their partnership with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Butter,’ which hit stores in June 2018. The minimalist silhouette features distinct center stitching on a reverse Primeknit upper, with the signature ‘SPLY-350’ inscription now printed on the interior side. The heel tab remains, finished in a bright yellow hue that matches the knitted upper, rope laces, and Boost-infused midsole.
